primary_source_receipts.locator: Reuters-syndicated coverage of the SpaceX IPO pricing and 12 June debut
primary_source_receipts.finding: Priced at $135, about 555 million shares, about $75B raised, about $1.77T valuation on 13.08B shares; first-day close about $160.95 (+19%); ticker reported as SPCX on Nasdaq.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Secondary coverage; opening-price reports conflict; the post-debut $2T+ figure is from a minor source.

primary_source_receipts.locator: Coverage of the S&P Dow Jones Indices megacap consultation decision (4 June 2026)
primary_source_receipts.finding: S&P kept the 12-month seasoning, GAAP profitability (positive latest quarter and four-quarter sum) and float rules; consultation opened 30 April; SpaceX 2025 net loss about $4.94B; Nasdaq-100 fast entry in 15 trading days; FTSE Russell five days.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Press coverage; S&P announcement not read directly.

primary_source_receipts.finding: Fair value about $780B (about $611B core launch and Starlink plus $170B AI scenarios), less than half the IPO target.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Coverage disagrees on equity vs enterprise value; report not read directly.

primary_source_receipts.locator: Executive Order, Democratizing Access to Alternative Assets for 401(k) Investors
primary_source_receipts.finding: Directs the Department of Labor (with the SEC) to revisit guidance on alternative assets, including private equity, private credit and real estate, in defined-contribution plans.
primary_source_receipts.limitations: Title and date by analyst recall consistent with the script; text not re-read in this session.
